coupling_convention: dimensionless g_ap (lower edge of excluded band)
notes: Paper derives constraints on ALP-proton coupling g_ap from a diffuse galactic SN ALP flux detected via a p->p gamma in Super-Kamiokande. Excluded region spans g_ap ~2e-5 to ~2e-4 for m_a ~1-70 MeV, above SN1987A cooling bounds. Pre-analysis hint of AxionElectron is WRONG; this is clearly AxionProton (Can=0, Cap=-0.47 fixed). The exclusion is a closed band; I emit the lower boundary (~2e-5) as the primary new limit across 1-70 MeV. Upper boundary ~2e-4 (above which ALPs are trapped). HK results are projections (not included here). Values read from Fig 4/6 description, hence approximate. 95% C.L. from Wilks/profiled log-likelihood. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 5))
